title: Explicit compatible-pair presheaf pullback cone
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Let $F,G,H:(\mathrm{Sch}/S)^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sets}$ be presheaves of sets (with natural transformations as in [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]), with values in the same universe as the schemes, and let $f:F\to H$, $g:G\to H$. Define the compatible-pair pullback cone of $f,g$ to have vertex the presheaf $P(T)=\{(x,y)\in F(T)\times G(T):f_T(x)=g_T(y)\}$, restriction $P(a)(x,y)=(F(a)(x),G(a)(y))$, and cone legs the two coordinate projections $P\to F$ and $P\to G$. Naturality of $f,g$ preserves the displayed equality. This definition applies to arbitrary presheaves; no sheaf or representability hypothesis is imposed.
